flashcard_questions.q: A speech in a play where a character speaks their thoughts aloud to the audience, usually alone on stage.
The underlying meaning behind what a character says, rather than the literal meaning of their words.
The point in a drama where the main character’s fortunes change decisively, usually from good to bad in a tragedy.
What pet name does Macbeth give Lady Macbeth in Act 3 Scene 2 when he shuts her out of his plans?
